   - Added the call to `add_host_and_content_length(c);` after setting the body length (`c->body_len = body_len;`).

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `src/flb_http_client.c` file addresses a bug related to the timing of when the `Content-Length` header is set. By moving the call to `add_host_and_content_length(c);` to occur after the body length is established, the patch ensures that the `Content-Length` header accurately reflects the size of the body being sent. This change improves the correctness of the HTTP client behavior by ensuring that the header is set with the correct value after the body is defined.
